'''Dusk 9''' was a top-secret [[Prison/Legends|prison]] that the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was rumored to maintain during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Highly classified, Dusk 9 was supposedly also the origin of many of the Empire's black ops projects, and carried out horrific [[Torture/Legends|tortures]] on its prisoners. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Zane (SIS)|Zane]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] headed an operation to locate Dusk 9 by seeding the Imperial prison system with hundreds of tagged Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], and he himself tried to be captured on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after [[Havoc Squad]] disrupted his operation with the [[Deadeyes]] unit, though Havoc Squad tracked him and the Deadeyes down again and forced him to withdraw.<ref name="TOR" />
